forge.name: Forge
forge.blurb: Ember creatures smelt ore into ingots. The Forge’s tier sets which weapons you can craft.
tiers: Craft tier 1 weapons you have blueprints for
Gilded cages and +50% ore from scrapping
Craft tier 4 weapons and +10% weapon damage

garden.name: Garden
garden.blurb: Fungal creatures grow food, herbs and spore silk for the whole hideout.

spring.name: Spring
spring.blurb: Tide creatures tend the healing waters and brew tonics from herbs.
tiers: Every creature gains 5 bond per day
Companions get +10% max HP in raids

roost.name: Roost
roost.blurb: Echo creatures scout the dungeon ahead of you.
tiers: Mark rooms that hold rare creatures
Show secret rooms on the map

vault.name: Vault
vault.blurb: Crystal creatures guard what you bring back and fire crystal dust into glass.
tiers: Keep your slot 3 creature if you die
Keep the weapons in your hands if you die
Keep 30% of raid coin if you die
Your slot 1 companion survives your death
Keep 60% of raid coin and all ore if you die

nursery.name: Nursery
nursery.blurb: Warden creatures watch over eggs. Needed for any breeding.
tiers: Breed one egg at a time, 2-day hatch
+0.5% mutation chance per gene, hybrid odds 15%
Three eggs, hybrids 20%, hatchlings start at Lv 5

training.name: Training Grounds
training.blurb: Any creature placed here trains every day for XP and bond. Trainees eat 2 food a day.
tiers: 45 XP a day and the Gene Lab opens
75 XP a day and the Trait Tutor opens

warroom.name: War Room
warroom.blurb: Gale creatures plan raids and weave hide and silk into cloth.
tiers: Start every raid with a random buff, unlocks Swarm mode

ARMORY_TIERS: Keep your primary weapon if you die

KEEPER_PERKS.2: Training Grounds unlocked, Pip the scout arrives
KEEPER_PERKS.4: War Room unlocked, Dr. Sorrel arrives

combat.name: Combat
nodes: Start every raid with a random buff
